name: encoding-reflection-template-set-read-whole
description: In Go, where every template that receives a value is one the analysis reads, a template engine reads only the fields those templates name: a set a variable holds that one chain of constant parses writes and that the program only executes. So a field of the page no template names is reported as written and never read, while a value executed through a template whose file name the program computes keeps every field.
